verdict.rationale: Bevy's docs list Web as a supported platform and host its examples compiled to WASM running in the browser via WebGL, so the 'runs in the browser on WebGL today' part is clearly covered. Nothing in the evidence addresses payload size or a WebGPU path, and that is half the story. Missing for 10: any WebGPU support or roadmap evidence, payload/bundle-size data, and independent hands-on reports of shipping web builds.
